name: Winegui
tagline: A user-interface friendly Wine manager that provides a graphical frontend for creating and managing Wine bottles.
description: WineGUI is a user-interface friendly Wine manager that provides a graphical frontend for creating and managing Wine bottles.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/winegui:4.5.1@sha256:e5fa5df6f9e566c7be2548ea9e547bcc5a41dc97fe7d31cdee6de107935a7ce8
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
